Hi Samantha / David —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood inference for customer-facing summarization and retrieval pipelines (reduce latency to < 150ms p50, and 30% cost reduction vs current).
- Success criteria: accuracy on your sample prompt set (F1 > 0.84), median latency, and integration effort.
- Scope for evaluation: 2-week trial with dedicated evaluation environment, shared prompt sets, and automated evals.

Next steps:
1) Schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff (demo + technical deep dive + trial plan) — I propose week of Apr 26.
2) Internal owners: Connor (AE) will run project plan; Marissa (CSM) will own evaluation logistics and success criteria.
3) Deliverables before kickoff: draft trial plan and sample prompt set; please share 5-10 representative prompts you want us to measure.

Available slots: Apr 26 10:00-11:00 PT, Apr 27 14:00-15:00 PT. You can also pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/connor-obrien/30min.

Attaching: redwood_trial_plan_v1.pdf and acme_eval_success_criteria.xlsx for an initial read.

If either of those slots works I will send a calendar invite and include a short agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
